prompt: What made Gutenberg’s printing method so productive?

options.text: Reusable metal type, a sticky ink and a press
Carving each page into a single wooden block
A steam engine driving the press

explanation: Gutenberg combined durable, reusable metal type with an oil-based ink and a press, so the same page could be printed many times.

prompt: Was Gutenberg the first person to print with movable type?

options.text: No: movable type existed earlier in China and Korea
Yes: nobody had tried it before

explanation: Bi Sheng invented movable type in China in the 11th century, and Korea printed the Jikji with metal type in 1377.
misconception: Gutenberg created Europe’s printing system, but movable type itself was older.

prompt: When did Brazil get its first official printing press?
explanation: The Portuguese Crown blocked printing in the colony; the Impressão Régia was created in Rio on 13 May 1808, after the royal family arrived.
